scopeAudit.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from exact Bigyra root 622CB. Every other Protists and Chromists species is explicitly out of scope.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Use only exact accepted ITIS Bigyra division TSN 969916 and exact accepted COL Bigyra phylum usage 622CB. The selected ITIS root has no accepted species, so no narrower or broader taxon is substituted and every COL row remains unmatched.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: Unavailable: the selected exact ITIS Bigyra root has no accepted species from which to derive a current-species partition.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: Unavailable: the selected exact ITIS Bigyra root has no accepted species and therefore no species-synonym partition.
statuses.ambiguous: Unavailable: the selected exact ITIS Bigyra root has no accepted species from which to derive candidate ambiguity.
statuses.unmatched: The exact COL Bigyra name has no candidate in the empty selected ITIS Bigyra accepted-species index.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, package-wide or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this small descriptor and may omit all row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include the descriptor and every listed row-level shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, exact COL and ITIS root audits, explicit empty ITIS species partition, representation-only normalization, code-unit ID ordering and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
